descriptions: Fixed characters failing to load entirely on servers with newer oxmysql — every database call died with 'attempt to index a nil value (field MySQL)'. The resource now imports @oxmysql directly, plus a built-in fallback that rebuilds the connection from oxmysql's exports if that import ever fails.
Fixed the UI breaking on windowed / smaller screens — on any window narrower than 1920px the character select and spawn map were squeezed and pushed off-centre.
Fixed custom spawn points never appearing on the map — the spawn map now fetches the list itself when opened.
Fixed the PLAY button / character info taking 5–30 seconds to appear on busy servers — the UI now confirms it's ready before the scene is revealed.
Fixed the select screen going completely blank from a typo in Config.CharacterDetail — invalid values now fall back safely and any UI error shows a readable message.
Fixed players spawning dead, falling through unloaded ground, or landing at the character-select location instead of their spawn.
Fixed character peds missing on clients low on asset memory — empty slots now recover automatically.
Resource download reduced from 113 MB to ~4 MB (removed 47 unused font files) and removed an external font dependency that could delay the UI by 5–30s.
Added per-spawn-point colours — add color = "#RRGGBB" to any entry in Config.SpawnPositions.
Added Config.AllowCharacterDeletion — hides the delete button and rejects delete requests server-side.
Added Config.ESXPassFullIdentifier for edited es_extended builds that don't append the licence to character identifiers (fixes rows saved as plain char1 and 'Duplicate entry' on create).
Added integration state for other resources — LocalPlayer.state.bablo_multichar_open plus bablo-multicharacter:client:opened / :closed events.
Added debug diagnostics (Config.DEBUG): build version banner, UI timing, and a NUI freeze detector.
[ESX] Fixed characters spawning as Michael instead of their saved appearance (skinchanger / codem-appearance), and HUD/status scripts not initialising until a manual revive.
[Qbox] Fixed 'all my old characters are gone' caused by a licence-column mismatch when looking up saved characters.
